lines.text: φοβερὰ καὶ ἐναντία καὶ βλαβερά.

summary.headline: Injurious Degrees and Planetary Aids
summary.text: Astrological doctrine on planetary aids, distinguishing the effects of Kronos and Ares by day and night, including help through Pan, Hermes, Pluto, and Poseidon. A list of degrees injurious to the eyes identifies stellar or anatomical markers in Leo, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Taurus, Cancer, Aquarius, and Capricorn.
